senses.gloss: the footstool in front of a high bed (Scamnum);

units: <cite ref="Nedarim 56a:7">Ned. 56ᵃ</cite> sq. the discussions about the meaning of our w., a. Maim. comment. to Mish. a. l.).
<cite ref="Mishnah Nedarim 7:5">Ned. VII, 5</cite> <he>הנודר … מותר בד׳</he> if one vows abstinence from ‘bed’, he is allowed the use of the footstool.

<cite ref="Moed Katan 27a:14">M. Kat. 27ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="C00156"><he>גַּדָּא</he></cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 2:9:4">Y. Ber. II, 5ᵈ</cite> bot.; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nedarim 7:5:2">Y. Ned. VII, end, 40ᶜ</cite>; a. e.
